data_fields.name: zone_frequency_base_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: table: none 0.0; extremelyLow 0.002; veryLow 0.01; low 0.03; medium 0.08; high 0.2; veryHigh 0.5; extremelyHigh 0.999

data_fields.name: min_jumps_from_owned_planets
data_fields.donor_constant: max(2, MIN_MONSTER_DISTANCE) krill; max(3, ...) drone factory; max(4, ...) dragon; MIN_MONSTER_DISTANCE = rule default 3 minus 1

data_fields.name: turn_spawn_density_per_system
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.01 (roll = systems x freq x 0.01, one roll per turn, unclamped)

best_idea: Give each spawn plan a counter set to its zone cap, check it before the roll and decrement it on each placed spawn, so the cap holds however many spawn points there are.
decision_why: Take the roll x per-plan cap x eligibility pass for zone population (row 23), but add respawn and despawn-on-empty with a grace timer, which this donor lacks, and keep the cap on the server ledger; do not copy the turn-pass trickle, which has no cap.
acceptance: A server test seeds a zone with a Krill cap of 2 and 200 eligible points; after 500 director passes exactly 2 Krill are alive, and no spawn is placed within the minimum jump distance of a player-held point.
